name: Manic EMU QoL
subtitle: Stripped-down Manic EMU for 3DS, DS and Game Boy
description: A modified Manic EMU with only Azahar (3DS), melonDS DS (DS) and mGBA (GBA, GBC, GB). Built automatically from github.com/duhdawgg/manic-emu-QoL-changes.

apps.name: Manic EMU QoL
apps.subtitle: 3DS, DS and Game Boy emulator
apps.localizedDescription: Manic EMU trimmed to 3DS (Azahar), DS (melonDS DS) and GBA/GBC/GB (mGBA). 3DS resolution (1x-4x) is now saved per game and applied at launch.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 12: first QoL build. Only 3DS, DS, GBA, GBC and GB. GB/GBC run on mGBA. 3DS resolution is remembered per game (1x-4x).

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Manic EMU requires the use of Bluetooth functionality to enable communication features for certain games.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access required to capture photos for custom game covers in Manic EMU
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Manic EMU needs access to your local network to find and connect with other devices for online gaming.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access required for full Nintendo DS game functionality in Manic EMU
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Manic EMU requires photo library access to save game screenshots and create custom game covers
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Manic EMU requires photo library access to save screenshots and select images for game covers
